Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  **No code changes made — this is planning only, per the high-impact flag on this ticket.**  ### What I found from reading the code (read-only)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `modules/auth`.  Contrary to the ticket's framing, I did **not** find an anonymous/local-storage fallback or a missing user check: - Every watchlist route (`GET /`, `POST /`, `GET /:id`, `PUT/DELETE /:id`, item add/remove) requires a valid `arca_session` co
